questions.explain: DMBOK is DAMA International's Data Management Body of Knowledge, its flagship reference publication.

questions.q: In the DAMA Wheel, what sits at the center?
questions.explain: Data Governance sits at the hub, with the other ten knowledge areas arranged as spokes around it, since governance underpins all of them.

questions.q: How many knowledge areas does DMBOK2 organize data management into, including governance?
questions.explain: DMBOK2 organizes the discipline into eleven knowledge areas: governance at the center plus ten surrounding areas.

questions.q: Which knowledge area is specifically about maintaining a consistent 'single source of truth' for entities like customers and products?
questions.explain: Reference and Master Data management maintains authoritative, consistent versions of core business entities across the organization.

questions.q: Per the lesson, why does DMBOK matter even at organizations that never formally adopt it?
options: Its vocabulary and structure have become the field's shared language, used even by companies that haven't read the book
It is legally required by every data protection regulation
It replaces the need for any data governance roles
It is the only framework ever used in the industry
questions.explain: DMBOK's terms (like 'master data management') are used broadly across the industry regardless of formal adoption — it's the shared reference vocabulary.
